title: The Unexpected Joy Of Being Sober

questions.q: According to a 2009 British report, which drug scored highest on health danger scale?
questions.why: Report ranked alcohol at 72, higher than heroin and crack.

questions.q: What does Professor David Nutt say should be the primary target to reduce societal drug harm?
questions.why: Nutt quoted that alcohol is the drug to target.

questions.q: How does the book compare building sobriety to physical training?
a: Like lifting the heaviest weight first
questions.why: It likens sobriety to building a muscle, start small and work up.

questions.q: What physiological effect of drinking reduces its long‑term appeal, according to the book?
questions.why: Drinking dulls dopamine release, making it less rewarding.

questions.q: Which health benefit is NOT mentioned as a result of quitting alcohol?
questions.why: Vision improvement isn't listed; other three are mentioned.
